label: 1. Hello, I am the manager of a hotel.

lines.speaker: cali
lines.text: Hello, I am the manager of a hotel.

lines.speaker: cali
lines.text: I do not wish to divulge too much information, but I will say that I live on Royal Road.

lines.speaker: cali
lines.text: I saw the latest renovation job that you were involved in.

lines.speaker: cali
lines.text: I have always dreamed of having similar decor in my establishment.

lines.speaker: cali
lines.text: The moment I laid eyes on that intoxicating blend of classical and modern styles,

lines.speaker: cali
lines.text: I knew you were the ones I had to have help me build a restaurant in my hotel.

lines.speaker: cali
lines.text: If you are willing to accept my offer, please contact me via this number.
